font_families.heading: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Noto Sans Tamil', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

rules.anti_default: Absolutely NO Inter, Roboto, or standard Sans-Serifs for headings. Use monospace everywhere to enforce the hacker terminal aesthetic.

rules.tinted_grey: Use zinc (cool tinted grey) instead of neutral gray.
rules.glow: Instead of background gradients, rely on colored text with drop shadows for the 'neon' effect.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Retro-Futurism (The Terminal Look). Use flat solid dark backgrounds with 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle CSS scanline overlay pointer-events-none over the entire layout (e.g., repeating linear gradient).
visual_enhancers.corner_radius: Strictly angular. Use `rounded-none` or maximum `rounded-sm` (2px) to keep the hard, technical edge.
visual_enhancers.hacker_motifs: Use ASCII brackets around labels (e.g., `[ SYSTEM ONLINE ]`), a blinking terminal cursor `_` at the end of the bot username, and monospaced data alignment.

structure.content: Bot Identity, Blinking Cursor, Live Status indicator (Right aligned or adjacent).

structure.span: col-span-12 md:col-span-4 for each of the 3 stats
structure.content: Conversions, Unique Users, Today. Stacked layout: Label top, giant number bottom.
Full width row. Show 'N sent', 'N failed', attribution ratio. Use green/red colored text for status.
Monospace URL display with a highly visible Copy button that switches to 'Copied' state.

layouts.spacing: Use tight padding within cards (`p-4` or `p-6`), but leave comfortable margins around the main container (`p-4 sm:p-8`).

components.cards: Raw `div` containers. Apply `border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/40 backdrop-blur-md p-6`. No shadows on the card itself, keep it flat.
components.buttons: Rectangular, dense. `border border-zinc-700 hover:border-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors bg-transparent`. For the copy button, include a Lucide icon.
components.status_indicator: Small rectangular badge. `border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-1 text-xs`. Must include a pulsing `w-2 h-2` dot.
components.charts: Recharts is permitted if a sparkline is added, but keep it minimal (emerald stroke, transparent fill, no grid lines, no axes).
components.icons: Use `lucide-react` with a technical stroke width (e.g., `strokeWidth={1.5}`).

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in and slight Y-translate (boot-up sequence effect).
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must snap or transition quickly (e.g., `duration-150`). Avoid slow, floaty animations.
motion.live_data: When numbers change, briefly flash the text color to white or cyan to indicate an update.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-to-background ratio is above 4.5:1. `text-zinc-400` on `zinc-950` is sufficient.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements (Copy button, links) must have `focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500 focus:outline-none`.
accessibility.motion_preference: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Disable staggered boot sequences if enabled.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST write in .js (React 19 + CRA), not .tsx.
Apply all CSS via Tailwind utility classes, avoiding App.css unless defining the scanline animation via `@layer utilities`.
DO NOT use rounded corners on cards (`rounded-xl` etc.). Force sharp edges to maintain the terminal hacker look.
DO NOT center align the app container. Keep a structured, top-down left-aligned flow.
The footer must accommodate the Tamil text 'தமிழ்' gracefully, ensure font stacking is respected.
Implement the 'Copy URL' functionality using standard browser clipboard API, showing a temporary success state.
Use framer-motion to create a 'system boot' sequence when the dashboard first mounts.
universal_guidelines: Never use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds under content; use backdrop blurs or dark semi-transparent overlays.
Every interactive element MUST include its specific `data-testid`.
Do not add universal transitions (`transition: all`), animate specific properties only.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk or standard Inter for this project.
